# Turn a messy product review into a polished customer testimonial with Cohere

**Hook:**
You’ve just received a heartfelt but messy customer review. By the end of this guide, you’ll be able to paste it into Cohere’s rewrite tool, click one button, and get back a clean, professional testimonial ready to share on your website or social media.

## Before you start
- A free Cohere account (sign up at [cohere.com](https://cohere.com))
- Any web browser on your computer or phone
- A raw customer review (one paragraph or a few sentences is fine)
- About 5 minutes

---

## Step 1 — Sign in to Cohere
Open your browser and go to [cohere.com](https://cohere.com). Look for a button like **Sign in** or **Log in** in the top-right corner. Click it. You’ll see a login screen. If you already have an account, enter your email and password. If not, choose **Sign up** and follow the quick steps to create one. You’ll land on the Cohere dashboard.

You’ll know it worked when you see your name or email in the top-right corner and the dashboard loads.

💬 Example:
If you don’t have an account yet, use:
💬 Example: `your.name@example.com` and a password you’ll remember.

---

## Step 2 — Open the Rewrite tool
On the dashboard, look for a button like **Playground** or **Tools** in the menu. Click it. A list of tools appears. Find and click **Rewrite**. A new page opens with a big text box at the top and a **Rewrite** button below it.

You’ll know it worked when you see a clean text box and the word **Rewrite** on a button.

💬 Example:
If you don’t see Rewrite, look for a button like **Text Rewriter** or **AI Rewriter**.

---

## Step 3 — Paste the raw review
In the big text box, delete any placeholder text. Then paste the messy customer review you want to polish. It can be a few sentences or a whole paragraph. Don’t worry about formatting — just paste it as plain text.

You’ll know it worked when the messy text appears exactly as you pasted it in the box.

💬 Example:
Paste this example:
💬 Example: "So yeah I bought this thing last week and it was pretty good but took a bit longer to arrive than I thought and the instructions were kinda confusing but once I figured it out it works great and I love how quiet it is now thanks!"

---

## Step 4 — Choose the rewrite style
Below the text box, look for a dropdown or set of buttons that say things like **Formal**, **Professional**, or **Customer testimonial**. Click the one that best matches your goal. If you don’t see these, look for a slider or toggle that says **Tone** or **Style**. Move it toward **Professional** or **Polished**.

You’ll know it worked when the label or slider shows your chosen style.

💬 Example:
If you see a dropdown, pick **Customer testimonial**.

---

## Step 5 — Click Rewrite
With your messy review in the box and the style set, click the big **Rewrite** button. Cohere will process your text and show a cleaner version in the same box. It usually takes just a few seconds.

You’ll know it worked when the new, cleaner text appears in the box and the button changes back to **Rewrite** or shows **Regenerate**.

💬 Example:
After clicking, you might see:
💬 Example: "I’ve been using this product for a week now and I’m really happy with it. While shipping took a little longer than expected and the instructions were a bit unclear at first, once I got started everything worked smoothly. I especially love how quiet it is — a big improvement!"

---

## Step 6 — Review and copy
Read the rewritten text carefully. If it’s not quite right, click **Regenerate** to get another version. When you’re happy with it, highlight all the text and copy it using **Edit > Copy** or **Ctrl+C** (Windows) / **Cmd+C** (Mac).

You’ll know it worked when you can paste the clean text somewhere else without any formatting issues.

💬 Example:
Copy the regenerated text and paste it into a new email or your website testimonials page.

---

## Common mistakes
- **Pasting the wrong text**: Double-check you pasted the right review before rewriting. If you pasted the wrong one, just paste the correct one and try again.
- **Choosing the wrong style**: If the rewrite sounds too formal or too casual, change the tone slider or dropdown and click **Rewrite** again.
- **Forgetting to copy**: After rewriting, don’t close the tab until you’ve copied the text. If you close it by mistake, just go back to the Rewrite tool and regenerate.

---

## What this means for you
- **In everyday life**: Turn a quick, honest customer message into a polished quote you can proudly share on your website or social media.
- **For your business or work**: Save time crafting testimonials from raw feedback, keeping your brand voice consistent and professional.
- **If you're just getting started**: This is a simple way to use AI to clean up messy text without learning complex tools.

---

## Try it now
Open [cohere.com](https://cohere.com), sign in, go to Rewrite, paste a quick review, choose **Customer testimonial**, click **Rewrite**, and copy the result. You’ll have a polished testimonial in under two minutes.
